exchange_type_quote: consumers who may be purchasing or changing their individual health coverage on the Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM) for 2027
exchange_type_quote_2: CMS state-marketplaces page (updated November 6, 2026): "For Plan Year 2027, there are 22 SBEs, and 2 State-based Exchanges on the Federal platform" [Tennessee is in neither list]
oe_quote: Open Enrollment runs Sunday, November 1, 2026 – Friday, January 15, 2027.
oe_quote_2: HealthCare.gov: "November 1: Open Enrollment starts ... January 15: Open Enrollment ends"; CMS July 31, 2026: "Open Enrollment at the Federally-facilitated Exchange will begin on November 1, 2026, and end on January 15, 2027."
oe_dec15_note: TDCI: "December 15, 2026: Last day to enroll in or change plans for coverage to start January 1" (release text says 'January 1, 2026', an apparent typo for 2027). "January 15, 2027: ... coverage starting February 1, 2027."
medicaid_program_name: TennCare (Tennessee's Medicaid program, Division of TennCare); not an ACA Medicaid expansion
medicaid_adult_income_limit_note: No coverage group for adults without children or disability. Parents and caretaker relatives of a dependent child under 18 (or 18 and a full-time student) qualify up to 100% FPL: TennCare categories page lists $1,330/month (1), $1,804 (2), $2,277 (3), $2,750 (4); Eligibility Reference Guide PDF (created Feb 20, 2026) shows the same figures; TennCare Policy Manual 015.040 (version dated Nov 2, 2026; income-standard section revised June 11, 2024) says 'The income standard for the Caretaker Relative MAGI category is 100% FPL.' No exact effective date of the current dollar table is printed. 2027 work requirement: TennCare says 'TennCare members will not experience an impact from Work or Community Engagement Requirements'; only certain parents/caretakers above $580/month are subject, and TennCare deems them to meet it from income on file. Non-citizen eligibility changes started October 1, 2026.
medicaid_quote: The community engagement requirement applies almost entirely to adults who receive Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansion, which Tennessee does not have.
medicaid_quote_2: IMPORTANT: TennCare members will not experience an impact from Work or Community Engagement Requirements.
medicaid_quote_3: TennCare does not cover all adults the way Medicaid expansion states do.
state_subsidy_finding: None found. CMS's Section 1332 waiver page (last modified 11/17/2026) has no Tennessee entry (state sections on the page: AK, CA, CO, DE, GA, HI, ID, IA, ME, MD, MA, MN, MT, NV, NH, NJ, ND, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, VA, VT, WA, WI; CA and MA appear only as applications, not approvals). TDCI's Oct 29, 2026 open-enrollment release mentions only federal tax credits ('calculate applicable tax credits') and no state premium program.

copy.medicaid: Tennessee has not expanded Medicaid. TennCare does not cover all low-income adults the way expansion states do. It does cover parents and caretaker relatives with income up to 100% of the federal poverty level. TennCare’s current guide lists that as $2,277 a month for a family of three. TennCare says the federal work rules that begin in 2027 will not affect its members.

notes_unverified: No exact effective date is printed on TennCare's current dollar table. The amounts match the 2026 federal poverty guidelines (100% FPL for 1 person = $15,960/yr), the PDF guide was created Feb 20, 2026, and the 100% FPL standard appears in the policy manual section revised June 11, 2024. The CMS approval date for raising the parent limit to 100% FPL was not confirmed from a primary page.

No Tennessee state premium subsidy or reinsurance program was found (CMS 1332 list, TDCI release). Absence was not exhaustively verified against every state source; state_subsidy_or_reinsurance_note set to null.
TDCI's Oct 29, 2026 release says 'coverage to start January 1, 2026' for the Dec 15 deadline; this is an apparent typo for 2027 (HealthCare.gov shows the same Dec 15 -> Jan 1 rule for 2027).

TennCare's notice says certain parents/caretakers above $580 a month are subject to the federal work rule but are deemed to meet it from income on file; copy summarizes this as 'will not affect its members' based on TennCare's own statement.

Coverage gap: HealthCare.gov's Medicaid-expansion page says in non-expansion states, adults under the poverty level who do not qualify for Medicaid won't qualify for Medicaid or Marketplace savings. Not used in copy (state-specific text is not on the static page).

Checker: the $2,277 figure matches 100% of the 2026 HHS poverty guideline for 3 people but TennCare prints no effective date; copy calls it TennCare's 'current guide' rather than naming a year. Re-check when the 2027 guidelines are published.

Checker: the PDF policy manual section CaretakerRelativeMAGI.pdf has a footer date of November 02, 2026 and PDF metadata created Oct 28, 2026 / modified Oct 29, 2026; its worked budget example says it is 'current as of June 2024'.

Parent/caretaker limit 100% FPL and $2,277/month for 3 confirmed on TennCare categories page, Eligibility Reference Guide page and PDF (created Feb 20, 2026), and Policy Manual 015.040.
